items.t: Oil sludge or coolant in the oil ruins the engine (2.7L)
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured 2.7L V6
items.note: Owners report $5,800-$7,600 for a replacement engine. Catching a leaking water pump early costs far less (one owner paid about $1,760).

items.t: Dropped valve seat destroys a cylinder (HEMI)
items.job: Replace engine with a remanufactured 5.7L HEMI
items.note: Owners report about $6,000-$6,500 installed. Repairing one head is cheaper only if the cylinder wall is not scored.

items.t: Automatic transmission failure
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Owner quotes range from about $2,500 to $4,800. If coolant got into the fluid, add a new radiator.

items.t: Shifter stuck in Park
items.job: Repair shift-lock or replace gear shifter assembly
items.note: Owners report about $280 typical and $355-$510 at a dealer for a new shifter.

items.t: Engine stalls or cuts out while driving
items.job: Replace crankshaft and camshaft position sensors
items.note: Diagnosis usually adds an hour. If the engine computer is at fault, the bill can reach $1,000-$1,800.

items.t: Stalls after filling the gas tank
items.job: Replace fuel tank vent valve, EVAP canister and purge valve
items.note: The higher end applies if the fuel tank itself must be replaced; owners report about $1,600 typical.

items.t: ESP light comes on and the car loses power
items.job: Diagnose stability control and engine codes
items.note: This is the diagnosis cost only; the repair depends on the faulty part found.

items.t: Clunking front suspension and fast tie rod wear
items.job: Replace front tension strut bushings, tie rod ends and align
items.note: Owners report $234-$700 per visit and about $1,380 when several parts are replaced.

items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts (HEMI)
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold bolts and gasket
items.note: Bolts cost about $100. Drilling out snapped bolts adds labor, and a warped manifold adds parts cost.

items.t: Gauges drop to zero while driving
items.job: Replace instrument cluster (used or new) and set mileage
items.note: Low end is a used cluster (forum owners list $60-$260 used, plus about $250 to correct the odometer/VIN); high end is a dealer cluster at about $940-$950. One owner paid $1,200 ($950 part, $250 labor). If a scan points to the front control module or power module instead, the cost differs.

items.t: Power module (TIPM) failure causes odd electrical faults
items.job: Replace and program the totally integrated power module (TIPM)
items.note: A used OEM 2005-2006 Magnum/300 TIPM sells for about $241; programming may be needed. A dealer quoted one owner $795 installed and another about $1,000-$1,200. YouCanic puts shop replacement at about $500 to over $1,000, or $200-$350 to send the old unit for repair. Labor hours are based on these installed totals, as no source states a book time.

items.t: Headlights and other lights flicker or cut out
items.job: Replace headlight switch (after testing the lighting circuit)
items.note: Prices the most suspected part, the headlight switch; the cause is not confirmed, so testing comes first. YourMechanic: $271-$306 ($88 average parts); RepairPal: about $213-$261 for 2005-2008 Magnums. Based on these estimators, as no parts retailer page was checked.

items.t: Rear power windows stop working
items.job: Replace rear power window motor, one door
items.note: YourMechanic: $367-$568 for a Magnum window motor ($136 average parts); shop/dealer $445-$1,038. Based on this estimator, as no parts retailer page was checked. A bad switch or connector costs less.

items.t: Key breaks inside and won't start the car
items.job: Buy, cut and program a replacement key/remote
items.note: Advance Auto lists Magnum remote keys from about $116 (aftermarket) to $230 (Dorman); a plain transponder key is about $38. Programming itself takes about 10-30 minutes; locksmiths are often cheaper than a dealer.

items.t: Driveshaft rubber coupling fails
items.job: Replace driveshaft flex coupling
items.note: Owners report about $500 typical.

items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.
